func NewBaseMessage(msgType Type, payload Payload, source string, opts ...Option) *BaseMessage {
	// Create message with defaults
	m := &BaseMessage{
		id:      uuid.New().String(),
		msgType: msgType,
		payload: payload,
		meta:    NewDefaultMeta(time.Now(), source),
	}

	// Apply functional options
	for _, opt := range opts {
		opt(m)
	}

	return m
}
